message.content:
Deep charcoal wool overcoat in a straight cut falling to mid-calf, #2b2b2b, heavy merino blend.  
Oversized black turtleneck sweater with a subtle ribbed texture and a relaxed fit, #1c1c1c, fine gauge cotton and wool mix.  
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in matte black fabric with a fluid drape and ankle-length hem, #0f0f0f, structured twill.  
Minimalist silver pendant necklace on a thin chain, #e8e8e8, polished sterling silver.  
Simple stud earrings in oxidized silver, #c0c0c0, smooth metal.  
Closed-toe leather pumps with a low block heel in a deep black shade and sleek silhouette, #1a1a1a, soft calfskin.  

This outfit honors the solemnity of a morning funeral while respecting her specific request for a "smart" or "formal" dress code without crossing into ceremonial white-tie attire. The dark, matte fabrics provide a respectful visual weight suitable for autumn daylight and mourning customs, creating a unified somber palette that complements her skin tone. By choosing wide-leg trousers and a straight overcoat instead of traditional suits or gowns, the ensemble balances dignity with a modern, understated elegance appropriate for an early morning service. The minimal silver accessories add just enough subtle detail to elevate the look without drawing attention away from the gravity of the occasion.
